issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): 27 unused public symbols in sdd clone, runner-slot capacity, and service host split modules
issue.description:
Found while fixing sase-13l. After the 13 private-import errors were fixed, `just _lint-symvision` still fails on origin/master (bbca06d9e) with "Unused public functions/classes" (a second error class symvision only reports once the private-import class is clear). sase-13l already fixed the ones in ace_tmux*.py and memory/selector*.py by making them private; these remain in other modules:

- src/sase/sdd/_store_clone_admission.py: acquire_remote_clone_permit, configured_remote_clone_concurrency, remote_clone_lock_dir, try_remote_clone_permit
- src/sase/sdd/_store_clone_remote.py: can_retry_without_reference, clone_attempt_telemetry, clone_attempt_timeout, matching_clone_reference, remote_clone_args
- src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_runner_slot_capacity.py: appears_as_agent, capacity_agent_family, capacity_record_is_live, capacity_run_started_at, capacity_timestamp, family_shell_id, family_shell_kind, family_shell_state, parsed_artifact_path, participates_in_runner_slots, tui_hold_membership_tribes, workflow_dir_name
- src/sase/service/host_support.py: gateway_builtin_argv, sase_command
- src/sase/service/host_reporting.py: observation, write_host_status
- src/sase/ace/tui/_proc_observer_models.py: is_gear_eligible_row
- src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/bgcmd_list.py: service_enablement_chip
- src/sase/completion/runtime_cache_generation.py: coherent

Fix per `sase memory read symvision.md`: make each private if only used in its own file (test-only references do not count), delete if dead, no pragmas. Note some are referenced only from tests (e.g. remote_clone_lock_dir, matching_clone_reference, service_enablement_chip), so those tests need updating.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Static and deterministic: symvision reads the import graph of unchanged source and reports the same 27 symbols on every run (reproduced twice in this workspace).

payload.description: Same class; sase-13l fixed the private-import errors and the tmux/selector unused publics that this one was masked behind

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_33 at clean master 86ff62c08: 'just _lint-symvision' still fails with the 27 unused public symbols named here (sdd clone, runner-slot capacity, service host split modules) and additionally aborts on "--epic-symbol 'sase-11y(read_service_environment)': symbol 'read_service_environment' is already properly used. Remove this unnecessary --epic-symbol entry." Discovered while closing sase-iu; my diff touches only two test files.

Independently reproduced on a stashed-clean tree at master 86ff62c08: `just _lint-symvision` reports the identical 28 unused-public findings in the same modules (the bead's file list totals 28, not the 27 in its title). Also ruled out as a cause of unrelated work: after my change the finding list was byte-identical to the clean base.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_32 at master 6087c0a8e: 'just _lint-symvision' reported 28 unused public symbols, matching this bead's file list. Two of the 28, is_gear_eligible_row (ace/tui/_proc_observer_models.py) and service_enablement_chip (ace/tui/widgets/bgcmd_list.py), were introduced by the sase-11y.7 Services-tab commit 92dd554c4 (git log -S) and are made private by the sase-11y.7 gate-repair change (in that worktree, pending its host-owned commit). With that change applied the gate lists exactly the remaining 26: sdd/_store_clone_admission.py (4), sdd/_store_clone_remote.py (5), ace/tui/models/_agent_runner_slot_capacity.py (12), service/host_support.py (2), service/host_reporting.py (2), completion/runtime_cache_generation.py (1). Those 26 come from the 2026-09-19 splits 3bfec5f70, 5b2583769, c18991b23 and 5082ca8cf; the two above need no further work here.

Independent reproduction (2026-09-20, service_git_credentials plan work): on clean master 52b028394 (changes stashed), `just _lint-symvision` reports the same 28 'Unused public functions/classes' in sdd/_store_clone_*, runner-slot capacity, service/host_support, service/host_reporting, proc_observer_models, bgcmd_list and completion/runtime_cache_generation (the list lists 28 names though the title says 27). Byte-identical to the list produced with my change applied, so none are mine. Impact: blocks the symvision stage of `sase tool run check`.

Independently reproduced 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_29 while repairing a rebase conflict for the visual-corpus commit (sase-12z.5.2). On origin/master 58f2de8f8 plus that commit (9a56fc129, which touches only agent_list.py, _agent_detail_panels.py, _display_panel_widgets.py and Agents visual tests), 'just _lint-symvision' still fails, now with 26 unused public symbols, none in files that commit touches. Since this bead was filed, 4833a49d9 privatized is_gear_eligible_row and service_enablement_chip, and 45df42549 restored the ace_tmux*.py annotations (sase-13k: 'lint (mypy)' now passes). Still open: sdd/_store_clone_admission.py (4), sdd/_store_clone_remote.py (5), ace/tui/models/_agent_runner_slot_capacity.py (12), service/host_support.py (2), service/host_reporting.py (2), completion/runtime_cache_generation.py (coherent). Impact: 'just check' aborts at the symvision stage and never reaches SASE validation, committed plans or the scoped test lane, so agents must run those stages by hand to verify anything.
